md: - **Telugu Language Day – 29 August**, birth anniversary of **Gidugu Venkata Ramamurthy** (not Gurajada); Telugu Language Awards the same day; **Telugu Mahotsavam** every year in AP.

- **Tikkana**: **Harihara Advaita** (unity of Shiva and Vishnu) – dedicated Bharatam to **Hariharanatha**; first work **Nirvachanottara Ramayanam** (to Manumasiddhi); **Kavi Vakbandham**, Krishna Satakam; disciple **Ketana**; first poet to receive a literary dedication.
